justification: Cousins has done his job every week he's been out there, so he stays under center. Dowdle and Corum both played hard and produced last week, and a back who's earning it doesn't lose his spot over a projection sheet - they're starting again. Wan'Dale had a quiet one last week, but I saw effort, not a man dogging it, so he gets his one more week to respond at WR2, same as Andrews at tight end after a down game - that's not a guy you bury. St. Brown's been doing real work and stays in the flex. Only change is at defense: Houston's sitting the bye this week, and I'm not leaving a hole in the lineup like we did back when the shoe was on the other foot with the Chargers - so LAC steps in, plain and simple, not a stat-chase, just filling the spot the right way. Clear eyes, full hearts, we keep showing up.
